title: desktop:/ protocol name appears on delete notification instead of the user-friendly path
line: Deleting a file on the desktop now shows "Desktop/name" in the notification instead of "desktop:/name" with %5B-style codes.
explanation: Files on the desktop are handled through desktop:/ URLs. For a single-file job without a destination (a delete), the notification shows the file's URL through JobPrivate::prettyUrl(), which only prettifies URLs inside a known place or local files; desktop:/ URLs fell through to QUrl::toDisplayString(), keeping the scheme and percent-encoded characters like [ and ]. The recent mostLocalUrl lookup only covers destinations and can't work for deleted files anyway. The change maps desktop:/ to the Desktop folder (fully decoded path) before the places lookup, so it reads Desktop/<name>; the link target is unchanged.

commits.message:
libnotificationmanager: Show desktop:/ URLs as a pretty local path

Deleting a file on the desktop showed the raw "desktop:/" URL in the
notification, with "[" shown as "%5B", since only places and local files
were prettified. Map desktop:/ to the Desktop folder before the lookup.

BUG: 526047

media.caption: Master: deleting "The Super Mario Galaxy Movie [2026].mkv" from the desktop shows desktop:/… with %5B2026%5D
With the fix: Desktop/The Super Mario Galaxy Movie [2026].mkv
Master: finished notification still says desktop:/…
With the fix: finished notification says Desktop/…
